claims.text: Over the 14 days from the patch, the positive share was +3.3 points against the interrupted time series estimate of what it would have been without the patch (90% range -0.4 to +6.9). That isn't enough to credit the patch: its 90% range includes no change at all.
Discount status and price changes were unknown during the evaluation window.
Off-topic review mentions remained at 0.0 percent of negative reviews during the window.
Composition changes contributed 0.18 points to the overall review share shift.
The positive review share was 95.09 percent across the evaluation window.

report.summary: The positive review share was 95.09 percent across the evaluation window. Over the 14 days from the patch, the positive share was +3.25 percentage points against the interrupted time series estimate of what it would have been without the patch, with a 90% range of -0.4 to +6.9. Composition changes contributed 0.18 percentage points to the overall review share shift, and off-topic review mentions remained at 0.0 percent of negative reviews. Discount status and price changes were unknown. H5 is supported, H1 and H2 are inconclusive, and H3 and H4 are rejected.
